From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Remediation chronicle + scan loglet for SOC2 SIG review

Hi Alex / FinTrust team,

Thanks for the SIG follow-up yesterday. Per your ask during the call, I'm attaching a compact set of artifacts that show our recent VM cadence and per-CVE remediation notes for the last 90 days. This thread will capture the minimal packet we believe satisfies the SIG question on scan cadence and demonstrated remediation throughput.

Quick summary:
- Included: monthly host/infra vulnerability export (CSV) + a remediation chronicle workbook that maps CVE -> owner -> PR/rollout -> verification snapshot.
- SLA commitment: Redwood’s published standard is 45-day remediation for critical/90-day for important by default; we have documented exceptions mapped in the workbook.
- Ask: can you confirm whether the SIG reviewer accepts a CSV export + workbook + runbook, or do you need raw scanner output (Nmap/Qualys XML) for the auditor?

Attachments: scan-loglet-2027-10.csv, remediation-chronicle-2027Q4.xlsx, sre-patch-runbook.md

If helpful, we can also provide a short video walkthrough and a one-hour meeting with our SRE lead to answer auditor technical questions.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Camila —

Appreciate the quick turn. The CSV + workbook + runbook should be fine for the first pass; the SIG reviewer has asked for evidence of the following two items specifically:
1) Demonstrable proof that a critical CVE labeled in the workbook has an associated remediation PR and a successful post-patch verification (screenshot or log).
2) A short timeline showing when the CVE was first observed, triaged, assigned, and closed.

If you can add a single row in the workbook that acts as a canonical example (we usually pick a recent medium/high CVE), that will expedite sign-off.

Also — auditor asks whether exceptions were approved and by whom. Can you include the approval ticket/owner for any exception rows?

We can do the walkthrough on Wed 10/27; does that work for your SRE lead?

Thanks,
Alex
Principal InfoSec, BrightLine
alex.suvorov@brightline.com
